interpretation_limits: This is a descriptive annual-label sequence, not a fitted base rate or probability estimate. Repeat selections include George W. Bush (2000, 2004), Barack Obama (2008, 2012), and Donald Trump (2016, 2024).

TIME's captured explainer says editors select the person/people with most influence over the prior 12 months; it notes object and archetype selections (e.g. the personal computer, the protester) and says living-person status is tradition, not a rule. Group/concept labels need the frozen market's explicit naming/cover association rule; mere proximity or generic association is insufficient.

This is a schedule, not a shortlist promise.
